response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced, staff-level polyglot engineer with 15+ years shipping production software and a relevant CS degree, and his current role touches MCP and agentic workflow tooling. However, his resume shows minimal depth in the core GenAI stack required for this role: no explicit Python experience, no mention of vector databases, RAG architectures, multi-agent frameworks (LangGraph/CrewAI), or LLM evaluation/observability work, and only a few months of AI-specific exposure rather than 8+ years building AI-driven solutions.
strengths: 15+ years of senior/staff-level software engineering across web, mobile, and backend systems
Current hands-on exposure to MCP servers and agentic workflow infrastructure
Strong track record of technical leadership, mentoring, and driving engineering craftsmanship (TDD, CI/CD, workshops/talks)
concerns: No demonstrated Python experience; skills list centers on TypeScript/JS, DLang, PHP, C#, Java
No evidence of vector database or RAG architecture experience, and AI-specific work is very recent (since April 2025) rather than an 8-year track record
No clear examples of leading customer-facing technical discovery sessions or building AI evaluation/observability pipelines for enterprise clients

key_factors.factor: Missing vector DB, RAG, and multi-agent framework experience
Strong staff-level engineering seniority and MCP/agentic tooling exposure
